question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

GRACEFUL
solution:
The correct answer is 'Awkward'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• Graceful is an adjective that means having or showing grace or elegance.
 
• The meaning of the given options is as follows - 
 
 
• Awkward - not smooth or graceful; ungainly.
 
• Polite - having or showing behavior that is respectful and considerate of other people.
 
• Refined - with impurities or unwanted elements having been removed by processing.
 
• Dignified - having or showing a composed or serious manner that is worthy of respect.
 
 
 
• From the above meanings, it is evident that awkward is the correct antonym for the word graceful.
 
• Hence, option 1 is the correct answer.
